acceptanceCriteria: Every normal and supported historical archive returns the complete full Outcome body in structured output; --json remains valid JSON and does not omit it.

The conversation-facing handoff is emitted from the same validated delivery payload, preserves WI identity, language, ordered segments, and body digest, and never substitutes archived, see attachment, or an agent-generated summary.
Host acceptance and display are derived only from per-message receipts; capability declarations alone cannot produce displayed or accepted status; zero sends cannot be reported complete.
Interrupted delivery resumes only from an identity-bound contiguous accepted receipt chain, with no new verification or archive execution; two consecutive Work Items remain separate.

When no supported host send API is configured, output explicitly states full_handoff_only and unknown display, and documentation identifies this as a capability limit rather than automatic dialog delivery.

CLI, MCP, and English/Simplified Chinese/Japanese presentation preserve the same facts and next action; focused tests inspect actual assistant-message event payloads at the controllable adapter boundary.
goal: Close the remaining HCI gap from the four-direction convergence review by making archive and supported historical-archive output reliably consumable as a complete conversation handoff, with explicit host limits and no duplicate verification or archive execution on retry.
intent: Deliver each archived Work Item Outcome as one complete, identity-bound human handoff in the conversation-facing path; distinguish tool return, host acceptance, display confirmation, and unknown capability without claiming unsupported Codex or Claude integration.
outOfScope: Do not implement or claim a built-in Codex or Claude send API; do not change lifecycle authorization rules
scope: Modify only the Outcome delivery contract and production paths in crates/cockpit-agent
and crates/cockpit-mcp; their focused tests; and the corresponding tri-language Outcome/Agent usage documentation and parity evidence.
